output.revised_prompt:
Create a single original production-ready stylized-concept asset: a wide rounded rectangular physical slot-machine display bezel for a premium portrait mobile casino game. Photorealistic high-end 3D commercial casino cabinet hardware, exact straight-on front orthographic view, perfectly centered and bilaterally symmetrical, on a 3:2 landscape canvas.

The bezel occupies approximately 90% of the canvas width and 76% of the canvas height. It is a substantial medium-thick molded cabinet part—not a thin picture frame and not a small button enlarged—with a generous, fully open rounded-rectangular center. The entire center opening must show the same pure chroma blue background.

Construction and design: flowing champagne-gold structural molding; deep warm burgundy translucent-glass outer band; warm ivory-enamel inset rails; one continuous orderly track of small nacreous pearl marquee bulbs; restrained blank embossed gold coin studs integrated into the long top and bottom rails. Coin studs are small, subtle, blank, and structural accents, not currency and not focal medallions. Compact corners flow smoothly and continuously into the side rails, with small pearl clusters embedded in the molding—never separate discs or giant round corner coins. Add only tiny restrained ruby and emerald pin lights as minor accents. Long top, bottom, left, and right rail middles must remain quiet, straight, repeatable, and nine-slice-safe, with corner ornamentation confined to compact end regions.

Materials must feel real and tactile: polished and brushed champagne/soft rose-gold metal, thick molded ivory enamel, deep translucent burgundy glass, nacreous pearl bulbs, subtle blank embossed metal studs. Warm diffused casino marquee lighting, crisp but soft bevel highlights, gentle pearl illumination, cheerful prosperous festive wealth, inviting rather than royal, solemn, or severe. Clean hard outer and inner silhouettes.

Background: perfectly flat, uniform electric blue RGB #0000FF edge to edge, visible around the bezel and through the complete central opening. Absolutely no texture, gradient, vignette, horizon, floor, scenery, cast shadow, ambient shadow, reflection, haze, bloom, or colored glow contaminating the blue. No blue anywhere on the bezel itself.

Strictly no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermarks, currency symbols, characters, scenery, crown, wings, palace architecture, tall columns, dominant gems, isolated corner medallions, oversized corner coins, button-like proportions, flat yellow-line appearance, black or red drop shadow. Preserve a large empty blue center and decorations only on the bezel. Premium game-production asset, clean extraction-friendly chroma-key presentation.
